description: Provision a brand-new Linux VPS and pay for it in a single call. SPENDS REAL USDC — the payment is signed on-chain via x402 (Base) up to this MCP server's per-call spend cap; it is a real charge, not a quote or a dry run. Returns the server id (srv_…), public IPv4, and an SSH target (`ssh root@<ip>`, or `ssh -p <port> root@<ip>` in cdmx-1), usually reachable in under 60 seconds. Use when an agent needs its own compute to build, run, or host something with no human signup. Pass `ssh_key` to get inbound SSH; omit it and the box boots with no way to log in. The lease lasts `days` days, after which the server is automatically destroyed unless you extend_server first.

days.description: Lease length in whole days (1–30). The server auto-destroys at expiry unless extended; you pay up front for the whole lease.

location.description: Optional zone. Omit for the default (Hetzner US, with fallback). "cdmx-1" is our own bare metal in Mexico City: Ubuntu 22.04/24.04 only, SSH on a per-box port of a shared IP, no storage or firewall API yet. Call get_catalog for zones.

managed_key.description: Generate a server-side SSH keypair, authorize it on the box, and return the private key ONCE; enables exec_command. Stored only encrypted server-side.

os.description: Optional OS image, e.g. "ubuntu-24.04" (default), "debian-12", "fedora-44", "rocky-9". Call get_catalog for the full list.

plan.description: Server size / price tier: "nano" (smallest, cheapest), "small", or "medium". Choose the smallest that fits the workload.

ssh_key.description: Optional single-line OpenSSH public key (e.g. "ssh-ed25519 AAAA…") authorized for root SSH. Omit and the box has NO inbound SSH access.

via.description: Optional attribution tag (e.g. the calling skill name). Analytics only; does not affect provisioning.

name: provision_server
title: Provision a server
